item.title: Version 1.4.9
item.changes: Camera Raw Filter now matches Photoshop's: white balance, light, color, mixer, curves, grading and vignettes Camera Raw previews update up to 20× faster Layer effects and live text survive Canvas Size, Image Size, Crop, Trim and adjustments Import WebP images ⌘ or ⌃ with a middle-button drag zooms Closing the last tab no longer counts up Untitled numbers Future updates list what's new right in the update window
